hero.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about RizqifyBD services, offers, and your account.

support.title: Still have questions?
support.description: Our support team is here to help you with your RizqifyBD experience.

general.a1: RizqifyBD is a Bangladesh-focused telecom offer marketplace that provides MB recharge, minute recharge, SMS packs, utility bill payments, and ticket support services — all in one platform.
general.a2: Anyone in Bangladesh with a valid mobile number can use RizqifyBD to purchase telecom services and manage their digital transactions.
general.a3: Yes, RizqifyBD services are accessible throughout Bangladesh wherever you have internet connectivity.

account.q1: How do I create an account?
account.a1: Click "Sign Up" on the homepage, enter your name, email, and password, then verify your email address. You can also register with a referral code if you have one.
account.a2: Click "Sign In" and enter your registered email and password. If you forget your password, use the "Forgot Password" link to reset it.
account.q3: Can I change my registered email or phone number?
account.a3: You can update your profile information from the dashboard after signing in. For security-sensitive changes, you may need to verify your identity.
account.q4: What should I do if I forget my password?
account.a4: Use the "Forgot Password" link on the sign-in page. Enter your registered email, and we'll send you a password reset link.

offers.q1: How do I find telecom offers?
offers.a1: Browse the Services or Offers section. You can filter by operator (Grameenphone, Banglalink, Robi, Airtel, Teletalk) and package type (Internet, Voice, SMS, Combo).
offers.q2: Are all offers available in every region?
offers.a2: Offer availability may vary by operator and region. Some offers are specific to certain circles or customer segments. Check the offer details before purchasing.
offers.a3: Each offer has its own validity period, which is displayed on the offer card. Validity typically ranges from a few days to several months depending on the package.
offers.q4: Can I purchase multiple offers at once?
offers.a4: Yes, you can add multiple offers to your cart and purchase them in a single transaction.

orders.q1: How do I check my order status?
orders.a1: Sign in and go to "My Orders" in your dashboard. You'll see the status of all recent orders (Pending, Processing, Completed, Failed).
orders.q2: What happens if my purchase fails?
orders.a2: Failed orders are typically refunded to your wallet automatically within a short period. If the amount doesn't appear, contact support with your order ID.
orders.a3: Orders can only be cancelled if they are still in "Pending" status. Once processing starts, cancellation may not be possible.
orders.q4: Where can I see my purchase history?
orders.a4: All past orders are listed in the "My Orders" section of your dashboard with dates, amounts, and status.

payments.q1: How do I add money to my wallet?
payments.a1: Go to "My Wallet" in your dashboard and click "Add Funds." Choose your preferred payment method and follow the instructions.
payments.a2: Supported payment methods include bKash, Nagad, Rocket, bank transfers, and card payments. Available options may vary.
payments.q3: How do I check my wallet balance and transaction history?
payments.a3: Visit "My Wallet" in your dashboard to see your current balance, recent transactions, and deposit/withdrawal history.
payments.q4: Can I withdraw money from my wallet?
payments.a4: Yes, you can request a withdrawal from "My Wallet." Withdrawals are processed to your registered mobile financial service account (bKash, Nagad, etc.) and may take 1-2 business days.
payments.q5: Are there any fees for deposits or withdrawals?
payments.a5: Deposit fees depend on the payment gateway. Withdrawal fees, if any, are displayed before you confirm the transaction.

agent.q1: Who can become an agent or reseller?
agent.a1: Any registered user with a valid NID and business details can apply. Approval is subject to verification and compliance checks.
agent.q2: What are the benefits of being an agent?
agent.a2: Agents earn commission on sales, get access to bulk purchase tools, and can manage sub-agents. Specific commission rates are shared upon approval.
agent.q3: How do I apply to become an agent?
agent.a3: Go to "Agent Application" in your dashboard, fill out the form with your business details, and submit for review.
agent.q4: What documents are required for agent registration?
agent.a4: Typically: National ID, trade license (if applicable), bank account details, and a passport-sized photo. Requirements may vary.

referral.q1: How does the referral program work?
referral.a1: Share your unique referral code. When someone signs up using your code and makes qualifying purchases, you earn commission.
referral.q2: What qualifies as a successful referral?
referral.a2: A referral is typically counted when the referred user completes their first purchase above a minimum threshold. Exact criteria are in the referral terms.
referral.q3: How much commission do I earn?
referral.a3: Commission rates vary by offer category and are subject to change. Current rates are visible in your referral dashboard.
referral.q4: When do I receive my referral earnings?
referral.a4: Referral commissions are credited to your wallet after the referred user's order is confirmed and any return period has passed.
referral.q5: Is there a limit to how many people I can refer?
referral.a5: There is no fixed limit on the number of referrals. However, fraudulent or spam referrals will be disqualified.

refunds.q1: How do I request a refund?
refunds.a1: Contact support with your order ID and reason for the refund request. Our team will review and process eligible refunds to your wallet.
refunds.a2: Refunds are considered for failed transactions, duplicate charges, or service non-delivery. Each case is reviewed individually.
refunds.q3: How long does a refund take?
refunds.a3: Approved refunds are typically credited to your wallet within 1-3 business days. Bank or MFS reversals may take longer depending on the provider.
refunds.q4: How do I contact customer support?
refunds.a4: Email us at info@rizqifybd.com or call +880 1607 950556. You can also submit a support ticket from your dashboard.
